title: 第6章 黑豹（求收藏推荐）
content_zh:
“我被盯上了！”
小区门前，李皓停下了自行车，缓缓推行。
“小皓回来了。”
“李巡检，晚上有空去我那喝一杯？”
“……”
小区中，正在纳凉闲谈的居民们，纷纷打起了招呼，很是热情。
三级巡检，在巡检司只是个大头兵，在小区中，却是足以给人带来安全感和威慑力，虽然李皓看起来文弱，没有其他巡检的威严。
“嗯，回来了。”
李皓露出笑容，纷纷回应。
启明小区，是个多年的老小区了，小区有些破败，李家在这住了很多年，李皓小时候记事起，李家就在启明小区定居了。
小区不大，总共就6栋楼，李皓住在小区最里面那栋，6栋302。
一路上，李皓没有骑车，推着自行车绕过了有些残破的路道，启明小区内部道路很久没有修缮，早已残破，骑起车来颠簸的厉害。
身后，隐约的议论声朝他传来。
“小皓这孩子，好倒是好，就是没长辈看着，有些不省心。你看好不容易考上了银城古院，居然又退学了，跑去当巡检了，真可惜了！”
“也不能这么说，巡检司多好，铁饭碗。”
“铁饭碗是没错，可古院毕业出来，挣钱多不说，比干个巡检有前途多了。”
“……”
议论声不算小，而且这样的话语，其实重复很多次了。
这一年来，李皓经常能听到这样的议论。
李皓也没管过，也不解释什么，没那个必要。

他还在思考刚刚的事，思考接下来自己如何应对。
怀中的枪，虽然可以带来一些安全感，却也没那么安全。
“还是缺乏对神秘力量的认知，而且我本身实战能力也有限，没了枪械，也就是个普通人。”
李皓学过一些格斗擒拿，不单单是巡检司需要，在银城古院，其实他也学过两年。
他的老师袁硕，不单单是一位学者，同样也是一位擒拿格斗的大师，当然，袁硕会擒拿格斗，不是为了打架，而是为了锻炼身体，可以更适应各种环境。
按照老师的话说，最起码一点，遇到危险，可以跑的更快。
古院的教授，每一次出外，其实都可能伴随着危机。
所以李皓也会一些，不过不是太精通，连头带尾，也就学了三年，和一般小混混比，那自然没问题，可和那些老巡检一比，其实也不怎么样。
“巡检的身份，未必有想象的那样有威慑力，也不知道能瞒多久。”
想着事，脚下忽然闪过一道黑影，速度极快。
李皓下意识抬腿想踢，很快收回了腿。
面前，一条黑色小狗也停下了脚步，没有叫唤，而是眼巴巴地看着李皓，好像在期待什么。
李皓笑了起来，将自行车停好。
“黑豹，速度好像变快了啊。”
黑豹，和这条瘦弱的小狗不是太匹配，不过李皓还是给它取了个霸道的名字。
这狗不是李皓养的，小区不知道哪里跑来的野狗。
李皓之前一个人生活，有些剩饭剩菜倒了可惜，见这狗可怜，时不时地喂养一下，几个月下来，这狗倒是认准了李皓，现在都不太流浪了，没事就在6栋楼道口趴着等李皓下班。
6栋其他人知道这是李皓喂的，尽管有人也怕狗，可三级巡检喂养的狗，也没什么人敢驱赶。
黑豹平时也不吵闹，左邻右舍也渐渐习惯了。
李皓蹲下身子，摸了摸小黑狗的脑袋。

一个人生活，时间长了其实很寂寞，而且还有事情压在心头，有条狗陪着，其实也不错。
可惜李皓太忙，也没时间管太多，顶多晚上回来喂点吃的，至于白天，有时候记得就留点狗粮，不记得也就任由黑豹自己寻食了。
“汪！”
小黑狗轻轻叫唤了一声。
“待会给你吃的。”
李皓笑了笑，笑的温和，也笑的真实一些，比在巡检司笑起来要真实许多。
起身，朝楼上走去。
破旧的小楼，破旧的楼梯，扶手都生锈了。
总共6层的小楼，如今一半人都搬走了。
如今，也就剩下一些老人在这养老归养，李皓倒是没搬走，也没钱去那些新小区买房子，何况这里是他一直住的地方，父母离世后，他也没想过搬。
黑豹跟着李皓一起往楼上跑，很是积极。
302。
房间不大，也就六十多平。
李皓敞开了屋门，黑豹也不进门，就在门口趴着，等待李皓投喂。
今日的李皓，没心思做饭。
找出了不知道有没有过期的狗粮，拿出黑豹的餐盘，倒了许多进去，将餐盘放到了门外。
“汪！”
黑豹尾巴摇曳，抬头看着李皓，好像在说什么。
“没买菜，今天先凑合着。”
李皓解释了一句，虽然根本不知道黑豹的意思，不过没关系，这狗也许是嫌弃这快过期的狗粮了。

“有的吃就不错了，别嫌弃，过些天，你还未必有的吃了，到时候自己去找吃的。”
李皓蹲下身子，看着黑豹不情不愿地开吃，笑了起来。
取出怀中的旋涡三代，考虑了一下，又将脖子上的玉剑取了下来。
把玩了一阵玉剑，李皓陷入了沉思中。
这玉剑，和神秘力量有关吗？
俚曲中的八大家，难道也牵扯到神秘力量？
可这么多年了，也没见这玉剑有什么特殊之处，至于什么滴血认主，小时候李皓不知道受伤多少次，也有血液沾染上玉剑，可没见有过任何反应。
“星空剑！”
李皓呓语一声，红影的目标是这个玩意吗？
“汪！”
就在这时候，刚刚还在吃东西的黑豹，忽然停下了动作，对着玉剑叫唤了一声。
李皓侧头看向黑豹。
黑豹则是对着玉剑，摇曳着尾巴，有些想靠近的冲动，又好像有些畏惧，没敢上前，只是隔着一点距离，睁大着狗眼盯着玉剑看。
李皓微微扬眉。
忽然心血来潮，陡然握着玉剑朝黑豹刺去，黑豹瞬间跳动，一下子跳开，动作极快。
这下子，倒是李皓有些惊讶了。
而跳开的黑豹，并未逃离，只是有些委屈的样子，又朝李皓叫唤了一声。
“嗯？”
李皓微微扬眉，黑豹有些怕这个玩意？
这倒是有意思了。

民间传说，白猫黑狗，有时候都能看到一些人类看不到的东西，难不成这黑狗在这玉剑上看到了什么？
黑豹很聪明，这点李皓还是知道的。
狗，都挺聪明的。
不聪明，这家伙也不会死赖着不走了，知道在这还有口饭吃。
“黑豹，过来！”
李皓招了招手，黑豹有些胆怯，有些迟疑，却还是慢吞吞地挪移了过来，狗眼一直盯着那玉剑看。
“汪！”
黑豹一开始有些害怕，渐渐地，因为有李皓在，又不是那么太害怕了。
李皓注意观察着它的反应，见状微微凝眉。
看样子，这玉剑还真有点特殊。
正想着，下一刻，李皓眼前一花，这次真没来得及反应，陡然手上一轻，等看清楚的时候，黑豹已经一口将玉剑给吞入了口中。
“卧槽！”
李皓愣神瞬间，下一刻，一把抓住黑豹的狗头，有些恼火道：“吐出来！”
该死的！
黑豹今天怎么了？
平时哪怕喂给它吃的，它也不会直接抢。
关键是，这狗今天有点贱啊。
一开始还一副害怕的样子，等李皓稍微走神一会，它就一口咬上来了，这算什么？
虚晃一招？
放松自己的警惕？

这年头，狗都会耍心眼了吗？
“呜呜！”
黑豹死死闭着嘴，就是不松口。
李皓有些愤怒了，捏着狗嘴，抓着黑豹的尾巴，不给它逃走的机会，也不给它有机会咬人，怒道：“白眼狼，我白喂你了！这是传家宝，你也吃！”
“吐出来！”
李皓松开尾巴，抓着黑豹的狗脖子，另一只手开始掰开狗嘴。
“呜呜！”
黑豹就是不松口，不过李皓劲还是很大的，强行掰扯，过了一会狗嘴被李皓掰开。
玉剑就在黑豹口中。
李皓有些无语，有些嫌弃，可星空剑事关重大，脏了也不能不要，他还是将玉剑给掏了出来，有些恼怒地使劲拍打了一下黑豹的脑袋。
“亏我平时还给你吃的，关键时候连你也不听话。”
“白眼狗！”
李皓训斥了一阵，这狗平时倒是老实巴交的，没想到这时候忽然给自己来了这么一套，也怪李皓对它防备心太低，居然真被这家伙给抢走了。
“都说咬人的狗不叫，还真符合你的身份！”
李皓又骂了几句，看着有些黏糊的玉剑，满是嫌弃和无奈。
脏兮兮的！
“汪汪！”
而此刻，黑豹也不挣扎，只是狗眼一直盯着玉剑看，好像有些舍不得，之前的惧怕，此刻早就消失了。
舌头还伸出来，想要再舔舔玉剑。
却是被李皓嫌弃无比地，一巴掌拍在狗脑袋上，硬生生缩回了舌头。

“汪汪！”
黑豹知道，这里谁才是老大，很快，狗眼看向李皓，带着一些讨好，一些祈求，好像希望能再舔舔玉剑。
李皓先是嫌弃，接着微微凝眉。
他看了一眼黑豹，黑豹平时不这样，很听话的，否则李皓不可能喂养它。
有时候李皓带着吃的，黑豹眼馋无比，可只要李皓不给，黑豹绝对不会上来抢。
“你想吃这个？”
李皓扬了扬玉剑，黑豹迅速盯着玉剑看，有些渴望，又有些纠结于李皓的话，好像在判断什么，很快，狗脑袋居然摇了摇。
“嗯？”
李皓一怔，听懂了？
狗通人性，听懂倒是也正常。
关键是，摇头是什么意思，不想吃？
不想吃你一直盯着干嘛？
刚刚还一把抢走了。
“奇怪。”
李皓喃喃一声，星空剑肯定有些特殊，这点他听到俚曲的时候就考虑过，可多年下来，李皓的确没有察觉到什么不对劲。
今日也是心血来潮，想仔细观察一下，才在黑豹身旁拿出了玉剑观察一番，结果一下子就出现了这样的变故。
若不是听到了俚曲，对玉剑有好奇心，李皓也许一辈子都会佩戴着，但是未必会取下来细看。
自然也就不会发生黑豹抢夺的事。
“黑豹这家伙，很想要，难道说，这东西对黑豹也有诱惑力？是对黑豹，还是对所有的狗？”
“星空剑到底有什么特殊之处？”

李皓的心思又扩散开了。
趁着他再次走神，这一次黑豹没有抢夺，而是陡然舌头伸长，吸溜一声，舌头再次舔在了玉剑之上，连带着李皓手掌上都满是它的口水。
李皓顿时嫌弃无比，伸手在它脑袋上来了一巴掌，在狗毛上擦了擦手，有些恼火。
“再抢，以后别想从我这弄吃的！”
“汪汪！”
黑豹居然再次摇头，尾巴疯狂摇动，好像在说，它没抢，就是舔一口。
这一次，李皓隐约觉得有些不对劲了。
他看了一眼黑豹，再看看玉剑，反正已经被这家伙舔的很脏了，待会肯定要清洗的，还得开水清洗才行。
想了想，李皓再次举起玉剑，“你还想舔？”
黑豹点头！
“成精了？”
李皓眼神微动，见鬼了，黑豹以前也聪明，可绝对没有今天这样，自己说什么，它好像完全可以听懂。
考虑了一下，李皓再次将玉剑递出，黑豹小心翼翼地看了一眼李皓，很快，舌头再次伸出，朝玉剑舔了一口，狗眼中居然满是满足感，好像每次吃完的那种满足感。
“黑豹为什么舔这个？”
“味道很好吃？”
才怪了！
小时候李皓没少舔这个，当然，现在想起来，李皓忽然有些发散思维，小时候父亲给我的时候，这玩意应该没洗过吧？
我居然舔了好多次！
那在父亲手中，或者说传承了这么多年，以前被狗舔过吗？
这要是舔过……哪怕没舔过，好像也很脏啊，都不知道被多少人戴过，自己小时候居然还经常含在嘴里。

“不能想，想了就恶心！”
李皓摇头，这东西别去想，只要一想，你吃过的东西，不知道有多少都会让你恶心，当不知道就行了。
“黑豹今天有些反常，不过也说明了玉剑的确有些不同之处。”
李皓心中猜测着，判断着各种可能。
很快，李皓起身，手上都是黑豹的口水，玉剑上也是，先洗洗再说。
回到屋内，李皓进入厨房，洗了洗手，接着倒了杯开水，将玉剑丢进了开水中，消消毒再说。
他准备等会去张远家看看，玉剑还是要带着的。
不带着，他怕被人偷了，当然，也怀疑玉剑是否可以当护身符，也许遇到红影，玉剑有点作用，这东西李皓可不敢丢在家中不管。
去年张远死的时候，红影没对自己出手，这玉剑是否也起到了一定的作用，此刻李皓也无法确定。
在开水中泡了一会，李皓取出玉剑，又用凉水冲洗了一阵。
刚准备将碗中的开水倒掉，脚下忽然有些动静。
“汪汪！”
黑豹居然进来了！
李皓怕黑豹掉毛，懒得打扫卫生，一般是不给黑豹进门的，黑豹也很乖，之前都不进门的，刚刚居然跟着李皓一起进来了厨房！
李皓低头看去，只见黑豹狗脸上满是期待，狗眼却是看向李皓手中的碗。
碗中，正是刚刚清洗玉剑的水。
李皓心中微动，忽然将碗放到了地下，黑豹甚至顾不得那还是热水，伸出舌头就疯狂舔了起来。
哪怕被烫的呜呜直叫，还是依旧不肯放弃。
“嗯？”
“水……清洗玉剑的水？”

李皓默默看着，心中猜测着什么，玉剑泡出来的水，难道有什么特殊之处？
“那也不对啊，我小时候没少舔，也没见有什么特殊的地方。”
当然，长大了，李皓不可能再干这种无聊的事。
此刻的李皓，愈加惊奇起来。
因为他好像察觉到了一点不对劲，正在喝水的黑豹，肉眼可见的，原本很杂乱干涩的黑毛，这一刻，隐约间好像柔顺了起来。
而黑豹的尾巴，摇动的更欢快了。
“水，泡了玉剑的水！”
“神秘力量？”
“古怪……难道说，玉剑的正确用法就是这样，泡水喝？”
李皓蹲下身子，再次抚摸黑豹，手感的确有些不一样了！
真的不太一样，更加柔顺了，没有之前的那种扎人感。
这一瞬间，李皓陡然看向手中的玉剑，忽然有些火热，难道说……玉剑泡水，水中会蕴含一些神秘力量吗？
自己一直苦求的东西，一直渴望接触的神秘力量，难不成……就在这碗水中？
“这……这要是真的，合着，我还是依靠一条狗，才发现了家传宝剑的作用？”
关键是，这剑，之前被狗舔了。
虽说开水烫了一会，可李皓还是有些嫌弃，当然，真要是有用，别说狗舔了，就是……反正就算恶心点，李皓也不会在意。
“星空剑上，难道蕴含着一些神秘力量，只是平时无法汲取，只能泡水，溢散到水中，才能被人吸收？”
李皓迅速转动脑筋，黑豹的毛发变柔顺了，这绝对不是一般的东西可以做到的。
能做到的，那一定和神秘力量有关。
这一刻，李皓忽然有些哭笑不得，这么说，我受到了一只狗的启发，可能发现了星空剑正确开启方式？

他看向黑豹，有些无言。
而此刻的黑豹，已经喝完了水，满是满足的表情，见李皓看来，尾巴摇曳的更欢快了，眼中好像多了一些之前不曾见到的灵性。
“这狗……感觉真的通人性了！”
李皓心中震动，效果这么好？
下一刻，他看向玉剑，忽然有些火热起来，黑豹喝了没事，还有好处，我呢？
我能喝吗？
我喝了，我能成为那神龙见首不见尾的神秘力量拥有者吗？
此刻，危机四伏。
若是能在这时候，掌握一些神秘力量，对李皓而言，简直就是救命稻草！
“喝了不会死人吧？”
应该不会，我小时候舔了那么多次，而且黑豹也只是普通的狗，它也喝了，舔了，没见它死了。
毒不死黑豹，大概率也不会毒死自己。
“要不试试……”
这个想法一旦滋生，李皓再也压抑不住了。
渴望拥有力量！
张远他们的死，今日被人跟踪，红影，巡夜人……
这一个个名词映入脑海，让李皓无比渴望拥有力量，他想方设法地进入巡检司，想接触巡夜人，就有窥探神秘力量的心思。
此刻，机会就在眼前，哪有放过的道理！
“我要试试，哪怕真的有事，不过一死，红影即将到来，巡夜人未必可靠，巡检司内部都是筛子，身边无人可用，无人可信……我还有什么可顾忌的？”
“干了！”

这一刻，李皓迅速做出了决定。
使劲拍了一下黑豹的狗脑袋，将迷迷糊糊的黑豹拍的有些发晕。
李皓振奋精神，低语道：“若是真的有效，真的有用，黑豹，以后少不了你的好处，跟着我吃香的喝辣的，那都不是事！”
“汪！”
黑豹叫唤一声，狗眼中满是期待，好像真的通人性了，此刻，好像也很期待李皓口中的幸福生活。

"I'm being targeted!"
In front of the community gate, Li Hao stopped his bicycle and pushed it slowly.
"Xiao Hao is back."
"Inspector Li, are you free to come to my place for a drink tonight?"
"..."
In the community, the residents who were enjoying the cool air and chatting greeted each other very warmly.
The third-level inspection is just a big shot in the inspection department, but in the community, it is enough to bring people a sense of security and deterrence. Although Li Hao looks weak and does not have the majesty of other inspections.
"Well, I'm back."
Li Hao smiled and responded one after another.
Qiming Community is an old community that has been around for many years. The community is somewhat dilapidated. The Li family has lived here for many years. The Li family has settled in Qiming Community since Li Hao could remember it when he was a child.
The community is not big, with only 6 buildings in total. Li Hao lives in the innermost building of the community, building 6, 302.
Along the way, Li Hao did not ride a bicycle, but pushed the bicycle around some dilapidated roads. The internal roads in Qiming Community had not been repaired for a long time and were already dilapidated. It was very bumpy when riding.
Behind him, vague voices of discussion came towards him.
"Xiao Hao is a good kid, but he doesn't have any elders to look after him, so he feels a little worried. You thought it was easy to get admitted to Yincheng Ancient Academy, but you actually dropped out of school again and went to work as an inspection officer. What a pity!"
"You can't say that. The Inspection Department is so good. It's an iron rice bowl."
"It's true that there is an iron rice bowl, but after graduating from Guyuan, not to mention making a lot of money, there is a much better future than working as an inspection officer."
"..."
The discussion was not quiet, and such words were actually repeated many times.
Over the past year, Li Hao has often heard such discussions.
Li Hao didn't care about it or explain anything. There was no need.
He was still thinking about what had just happened and how to deal with it next.
Although the gun in his arms can bring some sense of security, it is not that safe.
"I still lack the understanding of mysterious power, and my actual combat ability is also limited. Without firearms, I am just an ordinary person."
Li Hao has learned some fighting and grappling, not only for the inspection department, but also for two years at Yincheng Ancient Courtyard.
His teacher Yuan Shuo is not only a scholar, but also a master of grappling. Of course, Yuan Shuo knows how to grapple, not for fighting, but to exercise his body so that he can better adapt to various environments.
According to the teacher, at the very least, you can run faster when you encounter danger.
For professors from the ancient academy, every time they go out, there may be a crisis.
So Li Hao knows a little bit, but is not very proficient. He has only learned it for three years. Compared with ordinary gangsters, it is no problem, but compared with those old patrol inspectors, he is actually not that good.
"The identity of the patrol inspector may not be as deterrent as imagined, and I don't know how long it can be kept secret."
As he was thinking about something, a black shadow suddenly flashed under his feet at an extremely fast speed.
Li Hao subconsciously raised his leg to kick, but quickly retracted his leg.
In front of him, a black puppy also stopped and did not bark. Instead, it looked at Li Hao eagerly, as if expecting something.
Li Hao laughed and parked his bicycle.
"Black Panther, it seems like it's getting faster."
Black Panther was not a good match for this thin puppy, but Li Hao still gave it a domineering name.
This dog was not raised by Li Hao. It was a wild dog that came from nowhere in the community.
Li Hao used to live alone, and it was a pity that he threw away some leftovers. Seeing how pitiful the dog was, he fed it from time to time. After a few months, the dog recognized Li Hao. Now it doesn't wander much anymore. He just lies down at the intersection of Building 6 and waits for Li Hao to get off work.
Other people in Building 6 knew that this was fed by Li Hao. Although some people were also afraid of dogs, no one dared to drive away the dogs fed by the third-level inspection.
Black panthers usually don't make any noise, and the neighbors gradually got used to it.
Li Hao knelt down and touched the little black dog's head.
Living alone for a long time is actually very lonely, andAnd there are still things pressing on my mind, so it’s actually not bad to have a dog with me.
It's a pity that Li Hao is too busy and doesn't have time to care too much. He can only come back at night to feed him some food. As for during the day, sometimes he will leave some dog food if he remembers it. If he doesn't remember, he will just let the panther find food on his own.
"Woof!"
The little black dog barked softly.
"I'll give you something to eat later."
Li Hao smiled, his smile was gentle and more real, much more real than the smile in the inspection department.
Get up and walk upstairs.
The dilapidated small building, dilapidated stairs, and handrails are all rusty.
Half of the people in the six-story building have now moved out.
Nowadays, there are only some old people left to retire here. Li Hao has not moved out, and he has no money to buy a house in those new communities. Besides, this is where he has always lived. After his parents passed away, he never thought about moving.
Black Panther ran upstairs with Li Hao, very positive.
302.
The room is not big, only about 60 square meters.
Li Hao opened the door of the house, but the black panther didn't come in. He just lay down at the door, waiting for Li Hao to feed him.
Li Hao was not in the mood to cook today.
I found some expired dog food, took out Black Panther's dinner plate, poured a lot of it in, and put the plate outside the door.
"Woof!"
The black panther's tail swayed and he looked up at Li Hao, as if he was saying something.
"I haven't bought any groceries, so I'll just make do today."
Li Hao explained that although he didn't know what the black panther meant, it didn't matter. The dog might dislike the expired dog food.
"It's good to have some. Don't be dissatisfied. In a few days, you may not have enough to eat. Then you can go find something to eat."
Li Hao squatted down, watched the black panther reluctantly eat, and laughed.
He took out the Uzumaki Sandai from his arms, thought about it, and then took off the jade sword from his neck.
After playing with the jade sword for a while, Li Hao fell into deep thought.
Is this jade sword related to mysterious power?
Are the eight great families in the slang also involved in mysterious powers?
But after so many years, I haven't seen anything special about this jade sword. As for identifying the owner with a drop of blood, Li Hao was injured countless times when he was a child, and blood was stained on the jade sword, but he never had any reaction.
"Starry Sky Sword!"
Li Hao murmured, is this the target of Hong Ying?
"Woof!"
At this moment, the Black Panther, who had been eating just now, suddenly stopped and called out to the jade sword.
Li Hao turned his head and looked at Black Panther.
The black panther was facing the jade sword, wagging its tail, and had some urge to get closer, but also seemed to be a little afraid, so he did not dare to step forward. He just stared at the jade sword with wide-open dog eyes from a little distance away.
Li Hao raised his eyebrows slightly.
Suddenly, on a whim, he stabbed the black panther with his jade sword. The black panther jumped instantly and jumped away with extremely fast movements.
At this time, Li Hao was a little surprised.
The Black Panther who jumped away did not escape, but looked a little aggrieved and called out to Li Hao again.
"Huh?"
Li Hao raised his eyebrows slightly. Black Panther was a little afraid of this thing?
This is interesting.
According to folklore, white cats and black dogs can sometimes see things that humans cannot see. Could it be that the black dog saw something on the jade sword?
Black Panther is very smart, Li Hao still knows this.
Dogs are quite smart.
If he's not smart, this guy won't stick around, knowing that he still has something to eat here.
"Black Panther, come here!"
Li Hao waved, and the Black Panther was a little timid and hesitant, but still moved over slowly, his dog eyes always staring at the jade sword.
"Woof!"
The Black Panther was a little scared at first, but gradually, because of Li Hao's presence, he was no longer so scared.
Li Hao watched its reaction carefully and frowned slightly when he saw it.
It seems that this jade sword is really special.
Just as he was thinking about it, the next moment, Li Hao's eyes blurred. He really didn't have time to react this time. He suddenly made a light move on his hand. When he could see clearly, BlackLeopard had already swallowed the jade sword into his mouth.
"Fuck!"
Li Hao was stunned for a moment. The next moment, he grabbed the black panther's head and said angrily: "Spit it out!"
Damn it!
What happened to Black Panther today?
Even if you feed it food, it won't grab it directly.
The point is, this dog is a bit mean today.
He looked scared at first, but when Li Hao was distracted for a moment, he bit him. What does this mean?
A feint?
Let down your guard?
Do dogs get tricked these days?
"Woo!"
The black panther kept his mouth shut and refused to let go.
Li Hao became a little angry. He pinched the dog's mouth and grabbed the black panther's tail, not giving it a chance to escape or bite anyone. He said angrily: "White-eyed wolf, I fed you in vain! This is a family heirloom, you eat it too!"
"Spit it out!"
Li Hao let go of his tail, grabbed the Black Panther's neck, and started to open the dog's mouth with his other hand.
"Woo!"
The black panther refused to let go, but Li Hao was still very strong and forcefully pulled it apart. After a while, the dog's mouth was opened by Li Hao.
The jade sword is in the Black Panther's mouth.
Li Hao was speechless and disgusted, but the Starry Sky Sword was of great importance and he couldn't let it go even if it was dirty. He still took out the jade sword and slapped the Black Panther on the head with some annoyance.
"Thanks to me, I always give you food, but even you disobey me at critical moments."
"White-eyed dog!"
Li Hao scolded him for a while. This dog was usually honest and kind, but he didn't expect it to suddenly treat him like this. It was also because Li Hao was so low on guard against it that he was really snatched away by this guy.
"They say a dog that bites doesn't bark. It really suits your status!"
Li Hao cursed a few more times, looking at the sticky jade sword with disgust and helplessness.
Dirty!
"Woof woof!"
At this moment, the black panther did not struggle, but kept staring at the jade sword with his dog eyes, as if he was reluctant to part with it. The previous fear had long since disappeared.
His tongue was still hanging out, wanting to lick the jade sword again.
However, Li Hao was so disgusted that he slapped the dog on the head and retracted his tongue.
"Woof woof!"
The Black Panther knew who was the boss here. Soon, he looked at Li Hao with dog eyes, with some flattery and some prayer, as if he hoped to lick the jade sword again.
Li Hao was disgusted at first, then frowned slightly.
He glanced at the black panther. The black panther was not usually like this and was very obedient. Otherwise, Li Hao would not be able to feed it.
Sometimes Li Hao brings food, and the Black Panther is extremely greedy, but as long as Li Hao doesn't give it to him, the Black Panther will never come to grab it.
"You want to eat this?"
Li Hao raised his jade sword. Black Panther quickly stared at the jade sword, a little eager and a little entangled in Li Hao's words, as if he was judging something. Soon, the dog's head actually shook.
"Huh?"
Li Hao was startled. Do you understand?
Dogs understand human nature, so it is normal for them to understand.
The key is, what does shaking your head mean, not wanting to eat?
Why are you staring at it if you don't want to eat it?
Just snatched it away.
"Strange."
Li Hao murmured, there must be something special about the Starry Sky Sword. He had considered this when he heard the slang song, but after many years, Li Hao did not notice anything wrong.
Today I also had a whim and wanted to take a closer look, so I took out the jade sword next to Black Panther and observed it. As a result, something like this happened all of a sudden.
If he hadn't heard the slang and became curious about the jade sword, Li Hao might have worn it for the rest of his life, but he might not have taken it off to take a closer look.
Naturally, there will be no robbery by the black panther.
"The Black Panther wants it very much. Could it be that this thing is also attractive to the Black Panther? Is it to the Black Panther, or to all dogs?"
"What's so special about the Starry Sky Sword?"
Li Hao's thoughts spread again.
When he was distracted again, this time the black panther did not snatch it, but suddenly stretched out his tongue, sucked, and licked the jade sword again., even Li Hao's palms were covered with its saliva.
Li Hao was immediately disgusted, reached out and slapped the dog on the head, and wiped his hands on the dog's hair, feeling a little annoyed.
"If you keep grabbing it, don't try to get food from me in the future!"
"Woof woof!"
The black panther actually shook his head again and waggled his tail wildly, as if to say that he didn't grab it, just licked it.
This time, Li Hao vaguely felt that something was wrong.
He glanced at the black panther and then at the jade sword. Anyway, it was very dirty after being licked by this guy. It would definitely need to be cleaned later, and it would have to be cleaned with boiling water.
After thinking about it, Li Hao raised the jade sword again, "Do you still want to lick it?"
Black Panther nodded!
"Is he a sperm?"
Li Hao's eyes moved slightly. Damn it, the black panther was smart before, but it was definitely not as smart as it is today. It seemed to understand everything he said.
After thinking about it, Li Hao handed over the jade sword again. Black Panther glanced at Li Hao cautiously. Soon, he stretched out his tongue again and took a lick at the jade sword. The dog's eyes were full of satisfaction, as if he was satisfied every time he finished eating.
"Why did the black panther lick this?"
"Does it taste delicious?"
That’s weird!
Li Hao often licked this when he was a child. Of course, thinking about it now, Li Hao suddenly had some divergent thoughts. When my father gave it to me when I was a child, this thing must not have been washed, right?
I actually licked it many times!
Was it in the hands of the father, or had it been passed down for so many years, and had it been licked by a dog before?
If this has been licked...even if it has not been licked, it seems to be very dirty. I don't know how many people have worn it. I actually often kept it in my mouth when I was a child.
"Can't think about it, it makes me sick!"
Li Hao shook his head. Don't think about it. Just think about it. I don't know how many things you have eaten will make you sick. Just pretend you don't know.
"Black Panther is a little unusual today, but it also shows that there is something different about the Jade Sword."
Li Hao was guessing in his mind and judging various possibilities.
Soon, Li Hao stood up. His hands were covered with the saliva of the black panther, and the jade sword was also stained. He wanted to wash it first.
After returning to the house, Li Hao entered the kitchen, washed his hands, poured a cup of boiling water, and threw the jade sword into the boiling water to disinfect it.
He planned to visit Zhang Yuan's house later, and he still had to bring the jade sword with him.
If he didn't bring it with him, he was afraid of being stolen. Of course, he also doubted whether the jade sword could be used as a talisman. Maybe the jade sword would be useful when encountering Hong Ying. Li Hao didn't dare to leave this thing at home.
When Zhang Yuan died last year, Hongying didn't take action against him. Li Hao couldn't be sure at this moment whether the jade sword also played a certain role.
After soaking in boiling water for a while, Li Hao took out the jade sword and rinsed it with cold water for a while.
Just as he was about to pour away the boiling water in the bowl, there was sudden movement under his feet.
"Woof woof!"
The Black Panther actually came in!
Li Hao was afraid that the black panther would lose its fur and was too lazy to clean the house. He usually wouldn't let the black panther in. The black panther was also very well-behaved. He didn't even come in before, but he just followed Li Hao into the kitchen!
Li Hao looked down and saw that the black panther dog's face was full of expectation, but its eyes were looking at the bowl in Li Hao's hand.
In the bowl was the water that had just been used to clean the jade sword.
Li Hao's heart moved slightly, and he suddenly put the bowl on the ground. Black Panther didn't even care that it was still hot water, he stuck out his tongue and started licking it crazily.
Even though he was screaming from the heat, he still refused to give up.
"Huh?"
"Water...the water used to clean the jade sword?"
Li Hao watched silently, guessing something in his mind. Is there anything special about the water soaked in the jade sword?
"That's not right. I licked it a lot when I was a kid, and I didn't see anything special about it."
Of course, when he grows up, Li Hao will no longer be able to do such boring things.
At this moment, Li Hao became even more surprised.
Because he seemed to have noticed something was wrong. The black panther who was drinking water could see with the naked eye that the originally messy and dry black hair seemed to become softer at this moment.
And blackThe leopard's tail waggled more cheerfully.
"Water, water in which the jade sword was soaked!"
"Mysterious power?"
"Weird... Could it be that the correct way to use the jade sword is to soak it in water and drink it?"
Li Hao knelt down and touched the black panther again. The feeling was indeed different!
It's really different, it's more supple and doesn't have the irritating feeling before.
At this moment, Li Hao suddenly looked at the jade sword in his hand, feeling suddenly a little hot. Could it be that...when the jade sword is soaked in water, will the water contain some mysterious power?
Could it be that the thing that I have been praying for, the mysterious power that I have been longing for contact with... is in this bowl of water?
"This...if this is true and co-authored, I still relied on a dog to discover the function of the family heirloom sword?"
The key is that this sword was licked by a dog before.
Although it had been scalded with boiling water for a while, Li Hao still felt a little disgusted. Of course, if it was really useful, let alone a dog licking it, just... anyway, even if it was disgusting, Li Hao wouldn't care.
"Could it be that the Starry Sky Sword contains some mysterious power, but it cannot be absorbed normally? It can only be soaked in water and spilled into the water before it can be absorbed by others?"
Li Hao quickly thought, and the black panther's hair became soft. This was definitely not something ordinary things could do.
If it can be done, it must be related to mysterious power.
At this moment, Li Hao suddenly felt dumbfounded. So, I was inspired by a dog. Maybe I discovered the correct way to open the Starry Sky Sword?
He looked at Black Panther, somewhat speechless.
At this moment, the black panther had finished drinking the water, and his expression was full of satisfaction. Seeing Li Hao, his tail was swaying more cheerfully, and his eyes seemed to have some spirituality that he had never seen before.
"This dog... feels really humane!"
Li Hao was shocked. The effect was so good?
The next moment, he looked at Jade Sword, and suddenly he felt a little hot. Black Panther would be fine if he drank it, and there would be benefits. What about me?
Can I drink it?
If I drink it, can I become the owner of the mysterious power that the dragon has never seen?
At this moment, there are dangers everywhere.
If he could master some mysterious power at this time, it would be a life-saving straw for Li Hao!
"You won't die if you drink it, right?"
Probably not. I licked it so many times when I was a child, and the panther is just an ordinary dog. It also drank and licked it, but I didn't see it die.
If the poison doesn't kill the black panther, it most likely won't poison itself.
"How about giving it a try..."
Once this idea grew, Li Hao could no longer suppress it.
Desire to have power!
The death of Zhang Yuan and the others were followed today by people such as Hongying and the night watchman...
These terms came to mind, making Li Hao extremely eager to have power. He tried every means to enter the inspection department, wanting to contact the night watchmen, and he wanted to pry into the mysterious power.
At this moment, the opportunity is right in front of you, there is no reason to let it go!
"I want to try, even if something really happens, I will die. The red shadow is coming, the night watchman may not be reliable, the inspection department is full of sieves, no one around me is available, no one can be trusted... What else do I have to worry about?"
"Done!"
At this moment, Li Hao quickly made a decision.
He slapped the black panther's head hard, making the confused black panther feel dizzy.
Li Hao cheered up and whispered: "If it is really effective, Black Panther, your benefits will be indispensable in the future. If you follow me and drink spicy food, it won't be a problem!"
"Woof!"
The black panther barked, and the dog's eyes were full of expectation, as if it was really understanding human nature. At this moment, it seemed that it was also looking forward to the happy life that Li Hao said.
